name: merchantman_hagboat
description: Three-masted early-1700s merchantman / hagboat. Fore + main square-rigged, mizzen with a spanker, full standing + running rigging, 3 gunports/side, twin bower anchors, working steering. Fully rigged + skinned + animated.

axes.note: Controller orients the root to the game forward (rotate about up if the game expects bow = +Z, like the sloop).

materials.note: Procedural look baked to FOUR atlases split by texture group (sloop/brig pattern — never one shared atlas; that starves the hull). Each atlas = <tag>_albedo.png (sRGB) + <tag>_orm.png (R=occlusion=1, G=roughness, B=metallic). Babylon: metallicTexture=orm, useRoughnessFromMetallicTextureGreen, useMetallnessFromMetallicTextureBlue.

atlases.covers: hull / bulwark / wales — HERO surface, baked through a CONTINUOUS sheer-following 'plank' UV (not Smart-UV) so the planking stays continuous
deck furniture / beakhead / transom / carvings / gilt / iron / brass fittings

kept_separate.covers: the 13 Sail_* meshes ONLY. MUST stay separate — the client SailBillowPlugin binds to this material and vertex-displaces it; sharing would billow the whole ship.

kept_separate.note: KHR_materials_emissive_strength; add a Babylon glow layer

meshes.note: MERGED by animation-safety (2026-06-25): 122 objects → 22 meshes / ~30 draws (fixed 14→~28 FPS). Merchantman_Hull = 74 static parts; Merchantman_Rigging = 28 deforming morph-free parts (vertex groups preserved → mast-fall/trim/guns/wheel still deform); the 13 sails + 3 rope-morph meshes + 4 flags kept separate. Merged source: merchantman_opt.blend (authoring base merchantman.blend stays un-merged).

clips.name: Trim
clips.axis: yards: local Z yaw; B_Gaff: local Y yaw about the vertical mizzen-mast axis (gaff+boom+spanker+ensign swing as one)

clips.name: AnchorDrop_P
clips.axis: location down 3.4 m; rig_anchorcables cable pays out via gradient skin (no morph)

clips.name: AnchorDrop_S
clips.axis: location down 3.4 m; cable pays out

clips.name: MastDown_Fore
clips.note: carries fore yards+sails+flag; fore standing+running rig follows via foot->mast gradient; jibs drape on their stays, pinned at the bowsprit

morph_targets.note: Each sail has a Furl shape key (0=set, 0.5=partial/reefed, 1=furled), exported as a Furl_Sail_* NLA clip. Drive a sail's Furl AND its paired rope morphs (sail_sheet_pairs) to the same value. Flags have a Slack shape key (0=full wind, 1=limp).

sail_sheet_pairs.note: When furling sail S to value v, set each listed rope object's Furl_<S> morph to v too (square: corner ropes rise to the yard; jibs: rise+forward to the bowsprit; spanker: forward to the mast).

free_rotation.note: No clip — drive in code. B_Wheel spins about its LOCAL Y (the bone points along the fore-aft axle; local-Y rotation rolls the wheel in its Y-Z disc plane). Flags oscillate for a wind ripple (each flag also has a Slack morph for light air).

mast_damage.schema: three independent zones (fore, main, mizzen), each driven from its own mast HP.
mast_damage.driver_formula: mastFrac = 1 - hp/maxHp; scrub('MastDown_<zone>', mastFrac). Ease over ~1.5-2.5 s.
mast_damage.hinge_note: Mast topples about local X (sideways, over the rail); pole+tops+yards+sails follow (children); standing+running rigging follow via a foot->mast gradient skin so the rope FEET stay on the hull and stretch. Jibs drape on their stays, pinned at the bowsprit.
mast_damage.note: Break splinter morphs at the deck not yet authored (TODO polish) — masts currently hinge clean at the deck.
